beats.care: Carry earphones on your daily train and keep calls quiet. Repeat offenders who ignore warnings may face up to Rs 5,000, reports say.
beats.what: Southern Railway has warned passengers against playing music, videos, reels or games loudly on phones on trains and at stations.
beats.why: Many passengers complained about the noise. An order reportedly lets ticket inspectors and commercial officials collect fines.

opts: Use earphones and keep calls quiet
cards.q: What is the simplest way to stay on the right side of this rule?
cards.why: The warning targets loud audio without headphones, so earphones and a low voice are enough.

cards.body: Under the amended Railway Act, a Southern Railway users' committee member said. Up to Rs 5,000 for those who keep at it after a warning.
cards.caption: possible fine

cards.body: An order has reportedly gone to all railway divisions. Ticket inspectors and senior commercial officials can collect the fines.

hook: Watching reels out loud on the train could now *cost you Rs 1,000*

learn.t: A railway users' committee member says loud phone use can bring a Rs 1,000 fine, six months' jail, or both.
